Founder's Trifecta

Established 2025

Three Experts.
One Vision.

Founded in 2025, EVENTARA PH was born from a realization: top-tier marketing expertise shouldn't be reserved for the Fortune 500 alone. The agency was established by three friends and long-time colleagues—veterans in the elds of Sales, Brand Strategy, and Event Production. Having navigated the corporate ladder and spearheaded campaigns for major players, they recognized a disconnect in the industry. Agencies were either a ordable but inexperienced, or expert but exorbitantly priced. EVENTARA PH is the solution to that gap. Combining decades of collective experience, the founders united to democratize access to high-level consultancy and execution. We bring big-agency discipline with boutique agility. We utilize modern, data-backed techniques to ensure that every peso spent yields a tangible return. We are here to prove that premium service and accessible pricing can coexist.

Proven Track Record

Case Studies & Success Stories

Real challenges. Strategic interventions. Measurable revenue results.

F&B Viral Growth Revenue Case

Heart to Heart Grill & Hotpot

"From Local Spot to Viral Cravings"

The Challenge: Low brand recall, saturated hotpot market, and highly inconsistent daily foot traffic.
The Strategy: High-impact creative content ("Special Dip Sauce" tutorials & viral "Hotpot Christmas Tree"), Loyalty Gamification ("Hearties Loyalty Card"), and seasonal agility ("Sagot na namin ang Noche Buena") paired with targeted local influencers.

Key Results Delivered:

50%+ Daily Revenue
10K+ New Followers
Viral Brand Status
End-to-End Expo Fabrication

Excellent Noodles

"The Nationwide Flavor Roadshow"

The Challenge: Stand out in high-density trade expos while maintaining operational efficiency across tight setup windows.
The Strategy: 3D precision architectural rendering, modular structural fabrication, sensory activation (live cooking booth layout), and a streamlined logistical symphony loop.

Key Results Delivered:

100% 3D Design Fidelity
30% Setup Efficiency
Record On-Site Sales
Pharma & Mass Activation Landmark ROI

Unilab Activation Campaigns

"Driving Sales Through Strategic Engagement"

The Challenge: Convert general public health awareness into immediate product adoption across competitive pharmaceutical categories.
The Strategy: Direct consumer engagement kiosks, grassroots community outreach, health consultations, and rigorous field team quality control.

Key Results Delivered:

₱44,000,000+ Direct Sales Increase in 3-4 Months
Roving Experiential Caravan

Fresh Options

"Grand Anniversary Roving Caravan Campaign"

The Challenge: Celebrate milestone anniversary while driving immediate store foot traffic across multiple target barangays.
The Strategy: "Bringing the Celebration to You!" — Fully branded roving caravan truck, live cooking demonstrations, interactive games, instant prizes, and localized community engagement.

Key Results Delivered:

Multi-City Barangay Coverage
High-Foot Store Conversion
Direct Consumer Trial
